description: This PHP class defines a Drupal form for configuring navigation settings, including logo options, file uploads, and path validation.

classes.name: SettingsForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for managing navigation and logo settings, including file uploads and path validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies for configuration, file system, rendering, image processing, and theme management.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: getEditableConfigNames
methods.description: Returns configuration names that can be edited by this form.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the navigation settings form, including logo options and file upload fields.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form inputs, especially the logo path and uploaded image dimensions.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, saving uploaded logos and updating configuration.

methods.name: adjustLogoDimensions
methods.description: Resizes the logo image to fit within configured maximum dimensions.

methods.name: validateLogoPath
methods.description: Validates and normalizes the logo file path or URI.
